# apple_app_tag (Resource)

Chooses whether a tag Apple assigned to an app is shown on the App Store. Apple creates the tags; destroying the resource leaves the tag as it is. Import it with `<app_id>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_tag" "puzzle" {
  app_id               = data.apple_app.example.id
  name                 = "Puzzle"
  visible_in_app_store = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the tag, as Apple assigned it.
- `visible_in_app_store` (Boolean) Whether the tag is shown on the App Store.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_tag.puzzle
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    name   = "Puzzle"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the tag.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_tag.puzzle 1234567890/Puzzle
```
